data.text:
**CORS with React**

React apps typically run on a different port than the API, making CORS configuration essential.

During development, use a proxy to avoid CORS issues:
- package.json proxy setting
- Vite proxy configuration
- Custom proxy middleware

data.title: Vite Proxy

items: Deploy React and API to same domain when possible
Use reverse proxy (nginx, IIS) to route /api
Configure CORS for production URLs only

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Deploy to same domain when possible
data.takeaway: Proper CORS setup prevents frustrating development issues and security vulnerabilities.
